"髋部底形在两腿上端前，躯干覆盖腰部接缝。"}}
svg.title: Character — grouped flat-color drawing
svg.desc: 41 leaf groups drawn from this run reference. Character left is viewer right. Background transparent; body base shapes replace the temporary reference garment.
